details.biography:
Nadine Richardson (18 October 1977) is a production sound mixer. Born in West Sussex, England, her early training included studying sound and music technology. Between 2000 and 2003, she pursued studies in location sound recording at Ravensbourne College of Design and Communication. Before that, she studied music and technology at Morley College, followed by music studies at the School of Oriental and African Studies in London. Before transitioning entirely into sound work, she gained experience in various roles, including runner work, assisting with audio/video transfers, booking coordination, and studio support within London-based media groups.

Since about 2007, she has worked as a freelance sound mixer. Her credits span a wide range, from prominent studio features to independent projects, television series, documentaries and commercials. Among her notable film credits are Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022) and Secret Invasion (2023). On television, she has worked on high-end series, including Andor Season 2 (2023) and Top Boy Season 3 (2018).

She is a full member of the Association of Motion Picture Sound (AMPS). She maintains her base in the UK while working internationally.
details.name: Nadine Richardson
